# Ion Cazac

> Senior Product Designer · AI-Native Product Builder. 12+ years designing B2B SaaS, mobility, fintech and developer tools, from first idea to launch. I design AI-native products, prototype in code and build design systems teams ship with. Red Dot Award 2024.

## Availability

- Available now. EU citizen.
- B2B contract or full-time. Contracts are billed at a day rate, quoted per project.
- Remote for EU and US teams, or relocation within the EU. Based in Chișinău, Moldova (UTC+2).

## Selected work

- [Flovi](https://ioncazac.com/work/flovi): one customer portal for four markets. +30% customers, and booking takes about 20 seconds, 20% faster.
- [Digma](https://ioncazac.com/work/digma): a design system for all IDE plugins and the web app, plus the AI agents experience. Digma was acquired by JetBrains.
- [Profit.com](https://ioncazac.com/work/profit): an all-in-one trading app for iOS and web, with Arena, a trading game with prizes of up to $30,000 a month.
